title: [PS09/W19] Query bounded maintenance health, ownership and relevant drift
body: Implement original W19/A45 bounded fixed-five maintenance health: explicit configured owner, versions/latest attempt vs prior success, relevant changed paths, evidence-based fault categories, real tool repair and fresh re-drive. No scheduler/notifications, no Firstmate deep runtime, no whole-C0 or formal qualification claim. Root owns PR/central/full queue; 3 local workers author/independent/docs. Depends on PR311 W18; if parent remains open publish Draft stacked only, human merges.
